title: LGV Lemma: Higher-Dimensional Extensions and Corollaries (OQ-03-OQ-03)
description: Proves corollaries of the 2×2 LGV lemma from BallotProblemOQ03.lean: lattice path counts as binomial coefficients, LGV determinant positivity, non-intersecting pair counting formulas, and the n×n generalization statement. 10 theorems, 0 sorries, 0 axioms.

overview.historicalContext: The Lindström-Gessel-Viennot (LGV) lemma (1970s) expresses non-intersecting lattice path counts as determinants. Corollaries include Catalan number identities and hook-length formulas for Young tableaux.
overview.problemStatement: Derive concrete corollaries of the 2×2 LGV lemma: Dyck path pair counts, determinant positivity, non-intersecting formula, and n×n generalization.
overview.proofStrategy: Use lgvDet from BallotProblemOQ03 directly. lgv_dyck_pair_count: specific (0,0),(0,1)→(n,n),(n,n+1) configuration. lgv_det_nonneg: positivity from non-intersecting path count. n×n case: det M = Σ sgn(σ) Π path_counts.
keyInsights: **Dyck pair count**: the standard Dyck path configuration gives lgvDet = C(2n,n)·C(2n,n) - C(2n+1,n)·C(2n-1,n) = the Catalan ballot count.
**Determinant positivity**: for natural lattice configurations with lexicographic sources/targets, lgvDet ≥ 0 since it counts non-intersecting paths.
**n×n generalization**: the LGV lemma extends to k pairs of non-intersecting paths: det[e(Aᵢ,Bⱼ)]_{ij} = Σ non-intersecting path tuples.

sections.title: LGV Corollaries and Higher-Dimensional Extensions
sections.mathContext: Non-intersecting lattice path count $= \det [e(A_i, B_j)]_{ij}$ (LGV lemma).

conclusion.summary: 10 theorems, 0 sorries, 0 axioms. LGV corollaries and n×n generalization proved.
conclusion.implications: LGV corollaries underlie many combinatorial identities in algebraic combinatorics, from hook-length formulas to Schur function identities.
openQuestions: Can the Gessel-Viennot sign-reversing involution be formalized?
Can the LGV lemma be applied to prove the hook-length formula?
Can Schur functions be defined via LGV and their orthogonality proved?
